name: Oatstalk, Easily Alight
description:
Righteous anger from witnessing such brutality is justified. Ursus's manglers are well-trained, and their fangs do not cease just because of their victims' emotions. 
<Static Roadblock> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units. 
<Talulah, the Fighter> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.
